items.original_title: UAE says Omani flydubai co-pilot planned suicide attack on Tel Aviv flight
items.rss_summary: Oct 9 (Reuters) - An Omani flydubai co-pilot had planned to seize a Dubai-Tel Aviv flight and crash it into a terminal at Israel's Ben Gurion airport on September 30 in a suicide attack inspired by the September 11, 2001 attacks before he was thwarted by his fellow pilot, the UAE attorney general said on Friday, according to the state news agency. (Reporting by Enas Alashray and Yasmine Ghania; Editing by Kevin Liffey)
